market_commentary: DEMO ONLY: Long rates are restrictive, broad credit remains calm, AI debt supply is elevated, and the yen is close enough to the carry-unwind zone to require monitoring.
ai_credit_commentary: DEMO: Hyperscaler solvency is strong, but issuance volume, new-issue concessions and lower-quality AI borrowers create a sector-specific cost-of-capital warning.
fed_commentary: DEMO: September pricing is hawkish; a high probability of a hike keeps real yields and duration pressure elevated.

headlines.title: DEMO Fed repricing
headlines.impact: Higher rate expectations pressure long-duration AI.

headlines.title: DEMO yen/carry risk
headlines.impact: Rapid yen strengthening through 157 to 155 is a forced-deleveraging trigger.
